## Checks

- [ ] Tests, lint and typecheck pass for the apps this touches
- [ ] UI change: screenshots (dark; light if it changes a light theme) attached
- [ ] **Wiki / feature registry updated**: link the AlUmmahNowWiki PR that documents this and adds or updates its entry in [`features/registry.json`](https://github.com/Al-Ummah-Now/AlUmmahNowWiki/blob/main/features/README.md) (mention this PR there as `AlUmmahNowCMS#N`), or write "no user-visible change". The release run warns about PRs the wiki doesn't mention.
